title: seismic-utac: Earthquake Seismicity & Gutenberg-Richter SOC (GenesisAeon Package 23)
description: UTAC/CREP model of global earthquake seismicity. Models the Gutenberg-Richter power law as a CREP-mediated Self-Organized Critical (SOC) phenomenon. Calibrated against the IRIS 50-year global catalog (154,383 earthquakes, magnitudes 0.01–8.40, 6 global regions). Implements the Diamond interface (run_cycle, get_crep_state, get_utac_state, get_phase_events, to_zenodo_record) and yields Γ_seismic ≈ 0.200 at the crustal SOC regime (b ≈ 1.7). Part of the GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas Expansion (Packages 23–30).
notes: GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas — Package 23 of 30. CREP criticality position: Γ ≈ 0.200 (crustal SOC regime). The b-value decrease before major earthquakes maps onto rising Γ — a falsifiable UTAC precursor signal testable against SCEDC real-time data.
